rules.action: Review traffic and dust-control timing during observed PM2.5 peaks
rules.expected_direction: Lower PM2.5 during repeated peak hours if the source is confirmed
rules.limitations: Hourly model values do not identify emissions sources; confirm with local station data before action.

rules.action: Investigate local PM2.5 sources and assess dust-control options
rules.expected_direction: Lower particulate exposure if the identified source is addressed
rules.limitations: Model concentration alone cannot attribute pollution to traffic, construction, or other sources.

rules.action: Compare model PM2.5 with local monitoring before selecting interventions
rules.expected_direction: Improve confidence in the local air-quality assessment
rules.limitations: This is a monitoring recommendation, not evidence that air quality is worsening.

rules.action: Review heat-action readiness and shaded public-space coverage
rules.expected_direction: Reduce heat exposure if deployed in areas with verified vulnerability
rules.limitations: Temperature is modeled; exposure, humidity, and vulnerable population are not fully represented.

rules.action: Evaluate demand-response options near observed heat-related load peaks
rules.expected_direction: Reduce peak electricity demand if the relationship persists under intervention
rules.limitations: Correlation is not causal and the fitted line may fail outside observed conditions.
